name: infyicon
description: Search 161,000+ free hand-drawn icons and drop ready-to-embed SVG or PNG into your work. No API key.
long_description:
Infyicon gives Claude a free icon library of 161,000+ hand-drawn vector icons in four matching styles (outline, fill, color-outline, color-fill) plus a 61,000-glyph UI webfont.

**What Claude can do with it**

- Search icons by keyword (`search_icons`) or browse popular ones and categories
- Return the full SVG markup of any icon, one at a time or up to 20 per call, ready to paste into HTML, React, Figma, Canva or a design doc
- Give transparent PNG links at 16–512 px for email, docs and chat
- Suggest related icons so a whole set matches
- Look up CSS classes in the Infyicon UI webfont

**Free with attribution** to infyicon.com for personal and commercial use — see https://infyicon.com/license. Every tool is read-only and needs no account, sign-in or API key. This extension is a lightweight bridge to the hosted endpoint https://infyicon.com/mcp, so it is always up to date.
